title: Browse item-derived parameter records
changes: Expose the 31 bounded item-derived parameter records with source offsets and their stored byte and halfword fields.
Link authenticated European item selectors to their parameter records and provide a paginated, filterable reverse list with recognized localized item names.
validation: Protected unit viewer-item-parameters-synthetic-yoolwrlr passed 17 tests covering malformed inputs, source guards, language changes, filtering, bookmarks and item navigation.

Protected e347 unit viewer-item-parameters-real-4bagrcjs reconstructed 12032 item bytes and 124 parameter bytes against the source ROM, checked 376 item links and 31 records in Chrome, and matched 27 Python and Docker files.
Published 21 ignored wiki pages with guarded preimages while preserving other topic payloads.
limitations: The individual parameter semantics, live selector behavior and out-of-projection formatter inputs remain unproved. Other profiles do not acquire inferred item links; native Windows remains deferred.
